headline: Merchants Capital to Acquire Remaining Interest in VIUM Capital
summary: Merchants Bancorp announced that its subsidiary Merchants Capital Corp. entered into a definitive agreement to acquire the remaining interest in VIUM Capital, expanding its seniors housing and healthcare lending platform.
why: Merchants Bancorp is a specialized US regional financial holding company. Expanding healthcare and senior-care real estate financing increases fee revenue and lending diversification.

impacts.name: Merchants Bancorp
impacts.why: Merchants Bancorp agreed to buy the remaining stake in VIUM Capital to expand healthcare lending.
